x: Staines (Leicester) was leading the field, Charlie Churcher being our first man in 6th position, Percy Wright and Jack Rutland together 10th and 11th, and Charlie Redgrave 26th. Len Storey was leading the "B" team in 27th position, Charlie Speechley 29th (he was "gonged" a little while after this) and C.

When these men are joined by others, such as Don Brown, Fred Bentley, Bill Treacher, Len Storey, Jack Rutland, Reg. Elson, Eddie Heather and others, we may be sure our "Junior and "Senior" teams will command respect.
Heather and L. Storey, all experienced "Junior" racing men, have not been able to train regularly this year, but we hope to have their assistance next year.
Len Storey is another old 'un to visit us recently. How about bringing your togs next time, Len?
Rear:(Left to Right) L. Storey, A.L.Fletcher, A.A.Harley, R.F.Elson,H.E.Larman, J.E.Field, J.Rathbone, C.H.Speechley, F.W.Thorn, J.C.Bidgood.
